title: RuleCatalogue
description: Output of `sbom-tools rules -o json` and `sbom-tools rules explain <RULE_ID> -o json`: what the rule registry records about each compliance rule. Later releases may add fields without changing `schema`, so consumers must ignore fields they do not know. Field reference: docs/compliance-output.md.

rules.description: Every registered rule in registry order; with --standard, each standard's rules in the order its SARIF run declares them, then the standards' fallback rules; one rule for `rules explain`.

version.description: The sbom-tools release that produced the document.

id.description: The rule id: `rule_id` in `validate -o json`, `ruleId` in SARIF.

name.description: PascalCase name, the SARIF reportingDescriptor name.

description.description: What the check looks for, the SARIF shortDescription.

default_severity.description: The severity the rule reports at; a check may escalate or relax it by product class, CRA phase or context.

kind.description: `finding`: the rule reports violations. `pass`: it reports checks the SBOM passed, listed under `passed[]`, never as violations.

fallback.description: Whether this is a SBOM-<FAMILY>-GENERAL fallback rule: no check emits it, and the SARIF writer files a finding without a registered rule under it.

standards.description: Canonical --standard values of the standards whose reports carry the rule (`minimum`, `standard` and `comprehensive` for the quality profiles); for a fallback rule, the standards it is the fallback of.

references.description: The clauses the rule implements, in display order. Empty only for the quality profiles' own rules and some fallback rules.

help_uri.description: The rule's documentation link: the URL of the first reference that has one, else the page of the rule's standard.

remediation.description: How to fix a finding, in words that hold for every SBOM format.

standard.description: Referenced standard, as in a violation's `standard_refs`, e.g. CraArticle, Pren40000_1_3, NtiaMinimum.

id.description: Clause or requirement within that standard, e.g. Art. 24.

label.description: The reference as a reader cites it, e.g. CRA Art. 24.

help_uri.description: The standard's canonical URL, when one is known.

advice.description: Where the fix goes in each SBOM format. Absent when the fix is the same in every format.

text.description: The fix in this format, written to follow the format's name (`CycloneDX: set components[].version.`).

field.description: The field to set, in the format's own shape, e.g. components[].supplier.name, packages[].supplier, suppliedBy. Absent when the format has no field the check reads.
